# Feral Bear — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 11/35/5 — respec at levels 30, 50 and 60. The decision loop walks 71 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 51 (1 member), level 60 (8 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/druid/feral-bear/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **OK** — 90% of the human spec median (259 vs 288.5 boss DPS over 81 boss fights); tank; 2% hit / 1% crit [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [feral-bear.md](./feral-bear.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **DR00v-leave-bear-for-mark — cancel form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-343 (v43 party rules, orchestrator order 2026-10-18): the bear never left its form to buff members (DR00w casts in caster form only): out of combat in a party, in Bear or Dire Bear Form, with a living member lacking Mark of the Wild or Gift of the Wild (party.any_missing(1126), v43) it cancels the form so DR00w casts and DR01/DR02 re-enter. The exact rule of HO-TKB-PLAY-240 (level_min 10 instead of 20: the bear has the form from 10); the 60 percent floor on self.form_mana_pct (the druid's own mana, read while shapeshifted: Tick.cpp L1387-L1391, not rage or energy) is the cat rule DC00v's.
- **DR00w-mark-of-the-wild — Mark of the Wild:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22: a party whose only druid is feral got no Mark of the Wild): the restoration file's DS01 (party_missing, out of combat, not while drinking or eating), in caster form only, so it never takes the druid out of a form. It sits above the form rules, so in the caster-form window after a drink, a meal or a resurrection the buff goes out before the shift.
- **DR00x-thorns-tank — Thorns:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129: the restoration file's DS02 (Thorns on the party tank, the resident when it tanks) in caster form only, as the Mark above. HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic (1066) or Travel (783) Form: SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT, the cat file already had both.
- **DR00y-thorns-self — Thorns:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129: solo, Thorns on the druid itself (DS02b), in caster form only.
- **DR00u-mongoose — Use Elixir of the Mongoose:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of the Mongoose (item 13452, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 17538 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 209); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **DR00u-superior-defense — Use Elixir of Superior Defense:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of Superior Defense (item 13445, required level 43), elixir or potion (aura 11348 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 209); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **DR00u-free-action-rattlegore — Use Free Action Potion:** Rattlegore (11622) stuns; the Scholomance guide: pop a Free Action Potion 5-10 s into the fight so his stun misses (aura 6615, mechanic 11 immunity).
- **DR00u-greater-stoneshield-boss — Use Greater Stoneshield Potion:** HO-TKB-PLAY-218 (PIONEER FIX, endgame specs programme; kit sync ruling 2026-10-18: the kit is generated from the rules, so an item the guide wants needs a rule): Greater Stoneshield Potion (item 13455, required level 46, aura 17540 Greater Stoneshield, armour) on a boss once the tank has threat. No boss-burst list exists for our dungeons, so the trigger is the boss flag with threat opened and health at 60 per cent or more: a proxy, open question.
- **DR00q-aquatic-form — Aquatic Form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-140 (owner, 2026-10-08: druids use Aquatic Form for their own swims; the party buff is the shaman's or warlock's (HO-TKB-PLAY-139)): in water and out of combat, Aquatic Form (1066, quest at 16, instant): it breathes underwater and swims faster, so the druid needs no breath buff (p4-group's swim hold counts a druid as covered). self.swimming is the map's liquid at the resident (v28).
- **DR01-dire-bear-form — Dire Bear Form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-167 (PIONEER FIX, owner's loop pass after PIO-053): the aura test now also asks for 5487. Dire Bear Form (9634) is rank 2 of the Bear Form chain: the core casts it (rank_id 9634) but the CAST_SUCCESS and the aura both carry the first-in-chain id 5487, and auras_self lists first-in-chain ids (state-vocabulary), so `not aura_self(9634)` was true on every tick and the rule re-cast the form every 1.5 s, in combat too (round 144: 788 such casts on three bear tanks, Cressa on 5487 in 3255 of 3333 ticks and never on 9634; Cressa 2209, Mirethal, Ivenna).
- **DR02-bear-form — Bear Form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-140 (P1L39-C1): not while swimming: Aquatic Form holds in water, and on land or in combat the loop's stance push shifts back. Free, permanent, ShapeshiftForm bit 1 << 4, and a quest ability at 10 rather than a trainer one.
- **DR03l-growl-loose — Growl:** Growl reaches 5 yd (rangeIndex 2) and is off the global cooldown; the rule is for the bear (the file declares Bear Form as its stance).
- **DR05-frenzied-regeneration — Frenzied Regeneration:** The only self-heal a bear has, since every healing spell the class owns carries a stancesNot mask this form is inside. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **DR06-barkskin-feral — Barkskin (Feral):** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **DR07c-bash-caster — Bash:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): also on a runner (target.fleeing): "Runners: Feral Charge (from Bear) or Bash" (druid/leveling.md L159). 10 rage, 60 s categoryRecoveryTime, a 2 s stun; the interrupt, spent on a cast rather than on cooldown.
- **DR07-bash — Bash:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): also on a runner (target.fleeing): "Runners: Feral Charge (from Bear) or Bash" (druid/leveling.md L159). 10 rage, 60 s categoryRecoveryTime, a 2 s stun; the interrupt, spent on a cast rather than on cooldown.
- **DR08-enrage — Enrage:** At the pin Enrage is scripted (spell_druid_enrage, bound to 5229 by a world update) to cast 25503 for -27 per cent base armour in Bear Form, so a bear already under half health pays the armour where it hurts.
- **DR09-feral-charge — Feral Charge:** Feral talent (274) taken at 20; 5 rage, 15 s recoveryTime, 25 yd, and it closes and interrupts.
- **DR11b-demoralizing-roar-boss — Demoralizing Roar:** HO-TKB-PLAY-171 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator ruling "Roar only", observer's Hateforge fix 4): on a boss entry of the dungeon plan (target.boss) Demoralizing Roar goes out on the first tick the boss is inside 10 yd, ahead of Faerie Fire (Feral) at 105 and Swipe at 107.
- **DR12-faerie-fire-feral — Faerie Fire (Feral):** HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): in bear or cat only (stances 145): SPELL_FAILED_ONLY_SHAPESHIFT out of form.
- **DR14a-reshift-bear — Reshift:** HO-TKB-PLAY-240 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Reshift (cancel and reapply the current form, core spell_druid_reshift) when rage-starved: guide L103 "for a burst of rage when rage-starved, do not overdo it, since it costs Maul uptime", L19 "sparingly". Furor 5/5 gives 10 rage on the form aura (DB 17057, SpellAuras.cpp furor chance).
- **DR05a-entangling-roots-second — Entangling Roots:** The runtime backs a spell off after two pushes in a row that leave no aura on the target (p1-loop v12, ineffective_backoff for 10 s on that guid), so a creature that shrugs it off costs two casts, not a fight.
- **DR15b-moonfire — Moonfire:** HO-TKB-PLAY-030 (orchestrator: levels 1-10 before the forms): Moonfire rank 1 (8921, trainer at level 4, 25 mana) once per mob, the archive's caster phase: "From level 4, cast Moonfire once per mob" and then Wrath. Same guards as the Wrath rule beside it: in no form (Cat 768, Bear 5487, Dire Bear 9634), standing, and not while the target already carries it.
- **DR15a-wrath — Wrath:** HO-TKB-PLAY-030 (p3-runtime, the level-1 window): this file had no ability rule below the form level, so a feral druid of level 1-10 fought on auto-attack alone. Guarded out of every form (Cat 768, Bear 5487, Dire Bear 9634: a form cannot cast it) and below the approach rule, which is the staff melee once the mana is gone.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **DR00u-greater-stoneshield-boss:** No boss-burst list exists for our dungeons, so the trigger is the boss flag with threat opened and health at 60 per cent or more: a proxy, open question.
- **DR04-challenging-roar:** v42 expresses "a pack runs at someone else" as party.loose_count (the party's engaged creatures whose victim is a member other than the tank, v34) and "nearby" as enemies_within(10) (the roar taunts what is within 10 yd); three in each is the file's old pack size, the guide gives no number (open question P321-1).
